role.en: PhD candidate in Food Science, Jiangnan University; joint PhD training at the National University of Singapore.
role.zh: 江南大学食品科学与工程博士在读；新加坡国立大学联合培养。

bio.en: My PhD research is on human milk flavor, and my master's research was on the Maillard reaction of beef tallow residue. I use GC-MS, GC-O, electronic nose and sensory evaluation for analysis, and build models with machine learning.
bio.zh: 我的博士课题是关于母乳风味的研究，硕士是牛油渣的美拉德反应。平时用 GC-MS、GC-O、电子鼻和感官评价做分析，并通过机器学习进行建模。
